title: GROUNDING-AGENT-001: Grounding Agent v0.1 — read-only handoff truth check
intent: Add one narrow, read-only agent under tools/grounding_agent/ that verifies whether a structured handoff still describes the live repository before an implementation agent acts. It checks seven typed claim types (repo_head, pr_state, file_exists, local_path_exists, commit_ancestor, worktree_clean, active_lane) against live Git/GitHub(GET)/filesystem evidence and returns claim-by-claim verdicts with evidence classes, confidence, material divergences, and a MATCH/STALE/BLOCKED/INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE status plus a PROCEED/STOP decision. It never mutates state and never emits a remediation. Adds the tool package, a test package with 77 tests including five recorded historical stale-handoff fixtures and an AST-scoped anti-mutation guard, a governance spec and example request under docs/governance/agents/, and a minimal scoped CI workflow so the guardrails actually run in CI.

diff_articulation.what_changed: New read-only developer tool tools/grounding_agent/ (models, evidence/aggregation, engine, CLI, and git/GitHub-GET/filesystem adapters), a tests/grounding_agent/ suite (contracts, adapters, GA-001..020 engine cases, five GA-HIST fixtures, CLI exit codes, anti-mutation guard), a docs/governance/agents/ spec + example request, a CBSP21 patch manifest, and a scoped .github/workflows/grounding_agent.yml that runs the suite. No FastAPI runtime, client, schema, route, or build file is touched.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: No prior grounding/handoff-verification utility exists in the repo (only prose mentions in handoffs). This adds new capability — deterministic, evidence-classed, read-only verification of handoff claims — that nothing else provides; it is additive and does not duplicate any existing tool or governance script.
